context: Two teens swap weekend culture-and-sport plans
purpose: Teach: バレエ/ドラえもん/ビートルズ/プログラマ/格闘技/野外/湘南/博多

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 週末ね、母に付き合ってバレエの発表会を見に行くんだけど、その前に湘南でちょっと遊べないかな?
lines.en: This weekend, I'm going with my mom to watch a ballet recital, but before that, can we hang out at Shonan a bit?
lines.style: Casual teen girl, bright and inviting tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 湘南いいね!俺、土曜は野外の格闘技イベント手伝うことになっててさ、午後なら空いてるよ。
lines.en: Shonan sounds great! I got roped into helping at an outdoor martial arts event Saturday, but I'm free in the afternoon.
lines.style: Energetic teen boy, casual masculine speech with confidence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: え、格闘技?りく、いつの間にそんな世界に?ドラえもん見てた頃が懐かしいんだけど。
lines.en: Wait, martial arts? Riku, when did you get into that world? I miss the days when you were watching Doraemon.
lines.style: Teasing teen girl, playful and slightly nostalgic.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うるさいって(笑)。兄ちゃんが今ジム通ってて、その流れ。父さんはずっとビートルズばっか聴いてて全然興味なしだけどな。
lines.en: Shut up, haha. My brother started going to the gym, and I got pulled along. Dad just listens to the Beatles nonstop and isn't interested at all.
lines.style: Laughing teen boy, casual and self-deprecating banter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あはは、お父さん世代って感じ。あ、そうだ、夏休みに博多のいとこのとこ行くんだ。向こうでプログラマのおじさんにコード教わる予定。
lines.en: Haha, totally a dad-generation thing. Oh right, I'm going to my cousin's place in Hakata this summer. My programmer uncle is going to teach me coding.
lines.style: Excited teen girl sharing upcoming plans warmly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まじで?博多ラーメンも食ってこいよ。プログラマかー、桜って意外と理系狙いだよな。
lines.en: Seriously? Go eat Hakata ramen too. A programmer, huh — Sakura, you're surprisingly aiming for the science track.
lines.style: Impressed teen boy, casual and slightly admiring.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: まあね、バレエも続けたいけど、将来のことも考えなきゃじゃん。じゃあ土曜の三時、駅前でいい?
lines.en: Well yeah, I want to keep doing ballet too, but I gotta think about my future, you know? So, three o'clock Saturday at the station?
lines.style: Thoughtful teen girl wrapping up plans practically.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: オッケー、三時駅前ね。汗だくで来たらごめん!
lines.en: Okay, three at the station. Sorry in advance if I show up all sweaty!
lines.style: Cheerful teen boy confirming plans with humor.
